correctness.rationale: The channel on half a Bell pair gives Bell diagonal weights (1-p,p/3,p/3,p/3); for 0<p<1/2 the known Bell-diagonal formula is E_R=1-H_2(p), positive. Rubboli–Tomamichel establishes additivity for the Bell-diagonal factor, so E_R(rho_p^{⊗n})=n(1-H2(p)). Monotonicity under trace-preserving LOCC gives sup<=input while IDENTITY LOCC attains equality, proving the stated exact supremum; n E_R e^{-k n} is strictly smaller for n>=1,k>0. This is an analytic conditional mathematical correction to the displayed unrestricted optimization; no claimed impossibility of constrained distillation.
